description: LingQ is a language-learning platform for reading, listening, and studying lessons in multiple languages. It lets users import or access content and track vocabulary and lesson progress.
summary: LingQ exposes a documented legacy/REST HTTP API under `https://www.lingq.com/api/`, authenticated with a LingQ-issued API token sent in the `Authorization` header; public docs exist for legacy/v2, while forum posts indicate newer v3 endpoints are undocumented.
